t: Welcome — what this site is and how we work
s: A quick tour: what we publish, how we check facts, and how you can join the conversation.
x: Key takeaways We publish daily news, explainers, how to guides, videos and open discussions. Every post shows its sources, a fact check label and when it was last updated. We publish original, verified content — never made up quotes or numbers. You can comment on any post. Comments are reviewed before they appear.
